content: Considering that Grand Theft Auto 6 just launched after a 13-year wait, it’s safe to say that we won’t be getting another one any time soon. That’s fine, because Leonida is so enormous that I know I’ll still be finding secrets in it years from now. And yet, I can’t help myself. I’m already wondering where the series could possibly go next. Allow me to offer one unsolicited idea: Massachusetts.
